• "Facile" means demonstrating a lack of depth; oversimplified or achieved too easily. Its closest synonym is "Superficial". (सरल लेकिन सतही)

◦ Correct: Critics dismissed the politician's facile (superficial) solution to the complex economic crisis as unrealistic.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Unspoiled" (in its original, unspoiled condition; perfectly clean), Option 3 "Threatening" (giving the impression that something bad is going to happen) and Option 4 "Trivial" (not having any serious purpose or value; silly) are unrelated to the meaning of "facile".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of facile: superficial. Antonyms: profound, thorough.
